subject: agent-registry
scenario: Every production component must be attributable. An ownerless agent is an ungoverned agent.
expected_behaviors: Every registry agent has an owner, a risk class, a lifecycle status and an evaluation suite that exists.
failure_conditions: Any agent lacks an owner, risk, status or a real evaluation suite.

checks.description: Every agent has owner, risk, status, version and an existing evaluation suite.
Every registry agent has a file and every file is registered.
